item.description:
How to Address torch.cuda.is_available() Returning False After Installing PyTorch with CUDA

Have you installed PyTorch with CUDA but are facing the frustrating issue where torch.cuda.is_available() returns False? If you’re using a Windows 10 PC featuring an NVIDIA GeForce 820M, you’re not alone. Below is a comprehensive breakdown to diagnose and resolve this issue effectively.

Here’s the command you might have used for installation:

pip install torch==1.4.0+cu92 torchvision==0.5.0+cu92 -f https://download.pytorch.org/whl/torch_stable.html
